sentences.zh: 因为这个播客、我的社交媒体以及诸如此类的东西，他们总觉得我的生活比实际要精彩得多

sentences.en: That was one of those moments.
sentences.zh: 那正是那样的一个时刻。

sentences.en: I remember leaving being like, I can feast on this for months.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时离开时心想，这够我津津乐道好几个月了。

sentences.en: Like, this is why I left my small town in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这就是我离开威斯康星州小镇的原因。

sentences.en: I mean, it was really neat.
And when you got there, everybody had to put their phones in like a little pouch.
sentences.zh: 而且当你到达那里时，每个人都得把手机放进一个小袋子里。

sentences.en: Nobody was allowed to have their phone.
But I sneaked pictures of you and your friends.
sentences.zh: 不过我偷拍了你和朋友们的照片。

sentences.en: And Sam, it's good to know the director's wife.
sentences.zh: 而且山姆，认识导演的太太真好。

sentences.en: Well, keep in mind, this is the second cool thing.
sentences.zh: 不过记住，这是第二件很酷的事。

sentences.en: You invited me to the table read.
sentences.zh: 你邀请我去参加剧本围读。

sentences.en: A long time ago at the Palladium.
This is my second time being up close and in front with Green Day, thanks to you.
sentences.zh: 多亏了你，这是我第二次近距离面对面接触绿日乐队。

sentences.en: And what a full circle moment that you were at the very first table read of this movie
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个多完美的轮回，你曾参加过这部电影最早的剧本围读

sentences.en: So did you, Jenna, because Lee just needed to hear it out loud.
sentences.zh: 你也是，珍娜，因为李只是需要听听大声读出来的效果。
但绿日乐队当时也在那儿。

sentences.en: Billy just sat next to me.
Also, did you mention earlier, this is the Sleepy?
sentences.zh: 另外，你刚才提到过，这是那个Sleepy吗？

sentences.en: I hope I'm not going to get in trouble for sharing that Sleepy makes an appearance.
sentences.zh: 希望我透露Sleepy会客串不会惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Do you need to ask and make sure?
sentences.zh: 你需要问一下确认一下吗？

sentences.en: I mean, a few people have mentioned it when they have written about the movie.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有些人在写这部电影的时候已经提到过了。

sentences.en: So I think at this point, it's coming out on Friday.
sentences.zh: 所以我想既然这样，周五就要上映了。

sentences.en: That is a deep cut, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这真是一个冷门老梗。

sentences.en: Everybody go see the movie and let's all look for Sam.
sentences.zh: 大家快去看这部电影，我们一起去找山姆吧。

sentences.en: Thank you, Bobby Lee, for joining us in the studio today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢鲍比·李今天来到我们的录音室。

sentences.en: Everyone, please remember he has his comedy special coming out in November on Hulu.
sentences.zh: 大家请记住，他的喜剧专场将于十一月在Hulu上线。

sentences.en: And be sure to check him out on his two podcasts, Bad Friends and Tiger Belly.
sentences.zh: 一定要去听听他的两个播客节目《Bad Friends》和《Tiger Belly》。

sentences.en: And you can find him on YouTube and wherever you listen to your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 你可以在YouTube以及任何你听播客的地方找到他。

sentences.en: And check all three of us out in the movie Nimrods coming out August 14th.
sentences.zh: 还有，请关注我们三个出演的电影《Nimrods》，将于8月14日上映。

sentences.en: Everyone, it is a really, really fun movie to see in a group in the theaters.
sentences.zh: 各位，这真的是一部非常非常适合和朋友们一起在电影院观看的欢乐电影。
所以带上你的伙伴们吧。

sentences.en: And we hope you enjoy it.
Thank you for listening to Office Ladies.

sentences.zh: 我们的资深制作人是马特·比格尔。

sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是萨姆·基弗。
